firm_role_assignments_revoke_reason_chec.name: firm_role_assignments_revoke_reason_check
firm_role_assignments_revoke_reason_chec.value: "firm_role_assignments"."revoked_at" is null or "firm_role_assignments"."revoke_reason" is not null

trust_subledgers_owner_check.name: trust_subledgers_owner_check
trust_subledgers_owner_check.value:
("trust_subledgers"."kind" = 'client_matter' and "trust_subledgers"."client_party_id" is not null and "trust_subledgers"."matter_id" is not null)
      or ("trust_subledgers"."kind" = 'firm_cushion' and "trust_subledgers"."client_party_id" is null and "trust_subledgers"."matter_id" is null)

trust_transactions_shape_check.name: trust_transactions_shape_check
trust_transactions_shape_check.value:
case "trust_transactions"."kind"
      when 'deposit' then "trust_transactions"."net_amount_cents" > 0 and "trust_transactions"."funds_source" in ('client','third_party')
      when 'cushion_deposit' then "trust_transactions"."net_amount_cents" > 0 and "trust_transactions"."funds_source" = 'firm_operating'
      when 'disbursement' then "trust_transactions"."net_amount_cents" < 0 and "trust_transactions"."counterparty" is not null and "trust_transactions"."funds_source" is null
      when 'earned_fee_transfer' then "trust_transactions"."net_amount_cents" < 0 and "trust_transactions"."funds_source" is null
        and ("trust_transactions"."invoice_id" is not null or length(btrim(coalesce("trust_transactions"."earned_basis", ''))) > 0)
      when 'refund' then "trust_transactions"."net_amount_cents" < 0 and "trust_transactions"."funds_source" is null
      when 'cushion_withdrawal' then "trust_transactions"."net_amount_cents" < 0 and "trust_transactions"."funds_source" is null
      when 'bank_fee' then "trust_transactions"."net_amount_cents" < 0 and "trust_transactions"."funds_source" is null
      when 'transfer' then "trust_transactions"."net_amount_cents" = 0 and "trust_transactions"."funds_source" is null
      when 'reversal' then "trust_transactions"."funds_source" is null
      else false end

client_updates_ai_approval_check.name: client_updates_ai_approval_check
client_updates_ai_approval_check.value: "client_updates"."status" <> 'sent' or "client_updates"."author_type" = 'user' or ("client_updates"."approved_by_user_id" is not null and "client_updates"."approved_at" is not null)

court_notice_suggestions_decided_check.name: court_notice_suggestions_decided_check
court_notice_suggestions_decided_check.value: "court_notice_suggestions"."status" = 'open' or ("court_notice_suggestions"."decided_by_user_id" is not null and "court_notice_suggestions"."decided_at" is not null)

reply_clocks_close_reason_check.name: reply_clocks_close_reason_check
reply_clocks_close_reason_check.value: "reply_clocks"."status" <> 'closed' or ("reply_clocks"."close_reason" is not null and length("reply_clocks"."close_reason") > 0)

stall_watches_check_back_check.name: stall_watches_check_back_check
stall_watches_check_back_check.value: "stall_watches"."status" <> 'check_back' or ("stall_watches"."check_back_at" is not null and "stall_watches"."reason" is not null and length("stall_watches"."reason") > 0)

deadline_rule_sets_approved_check.name: deadline_rule_sets_approved_check
deadline_rule_sets_approved_check.value: "deadline_rule_sets"."status" <> 'approved' or ("deadline_rule_sets"."approved_by_user_id" is not null and "deadline_rule_sets"."approved_at" is not null)

limitation_dates_verified_check.name: limitation_dates_verified_check
limitation_dates_verified_check.value:
"limitation_dates"."status" <> 'verified' or ("limitation_dates"."verified_by_user_id" is not null and "limitation_dates"."verified_at" is not null
      and "limitation_dates"."verified_by_user_id" <> "limitation_dates"."entered_by_user_id"
      and ("limitation_dates"."last_changed_by_user_id" is null or "limitation_dates"."verified_by_user_id" <> "limitation_dates"."last_changed_by_user_id"))

limitation_dates_closed_check.name: limitation_dates_closed_check
limitation_dates_closed_check.value: "limitation_dates"."status" not in ('satisfied','withdrawn') or ("limitation_dates"."closed_by_user_id" is not null and coalesce(length(trim("limitation_dates"."closed_reason")), 0) > 0)

matter_closings_closed_check.name: matter_closings_closed_check

matter_limitation_profiles_decided_check.name: matter_limitation_profiles_decided_check

matter_stage_definitions_active_check.name: matter_stage_definitions_active_check

party_retention_requests_decided_check.name: party_retention_requests_decided_check
